---
title: "The CEO of Princeton Economics"
date: "2008-01-18"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets"]
---

Australia’s House Economics Committee may be cringe-inducing at times, but at least they generally know who they are talking to.  Here’s [Representative Marcy Kaptur, D-Ohio](http://www.salon.com/tech/htww/2008/01/17/marcy_kaptur_strikes_again/index.html "Representative Marcy Kaptur, D-Ohio"), grilling Fed Chairman Bernanke at a Budget committee hearing:

KAPTUR: Number three, seeing as how you were the former CEO of Goldman Sachs, what percentage level—oh, investment—were you not…\
BERNANKE: No, you’re confusing me with the Treasury Secretary.\
KAPTUR: I got the wrong firm?\
BERNANKE: Yes.\
KAPTUR: Paulson. Oh, OK. Where were you, sir?\
BERNANKE: I was a CEO of the Princeton Economics Department.\
KAPTUR: Oh, Princeton. Oh, all right. Sorry. Sorry.\
(LAUGHTER)

Also caught on [Youtube](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wnPnLvsl6Aw "Youtube").
